summary:
Plan of w132 written (plan.md). All 14 cases (v16a, v_d1 x5, v_d3, v17, v3, v18 x6) are red on missing Givens and on rules model.lp lacks.
The notes are partly stale: model_requests.py, the requests/ skip (D1 gone) and request in KINDS already exist on the base; the plan builds on them.
Decisions: fulfils is an initiative field; v16a compares with the literal 2026-10-23; a request's part_of/source go under request-only relations so v9e/v10a/v_k*/v_d2 stay silent on requests; asker 'this context' = internal or the context's own id; v_d1 keeps its part-open clause (r36) and adds r114's under one label; v17 counts job-thread part_of and origin-kind sources only (the v17 Given uses a non-job-thread part_of to pass r112's form); v3 replaces the dead needs rule as v3/2 over the resolution entries; v18 is judged in qualify from the id alone, own ids included.
No existing test breaks (RulesTest, label order and fixture dates checked). Open cases include v16a on this repository's own i24.
